description: Update a community role's name, description, or permissions.

main.description: Update an existing role. Cannot remove required permissions from owner role.

attestationTypes.description: Attestation types holders of this role may issue and revoke. Omit to allow every type.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: No role found with the given rkey.

errors.name: OwnerLockout
errors.description: Cannot remove required permissions from owner role.

errors.name: RoleNameTaken
errors.description: A role with this name already exists.

errors.name: CommunityMoved
errors.description: The community has moved to another PDS; this copy is read-only (#267).

errors.name: CommunityImporting
errors.description: The community is still arriving here and is not active yet (#267).

errors.name: CommunitySuspended
errors.description: The community has been suspended by the PDS administrator and accepts no writes.

errors.name: CommunityTakenDown
errors.description: The community has been taken down.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Community not found, or private and not visible to the caller.

errors.name: NotMember
errors.description: The caller is not a member of this community.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the required community permission.
